about: Round 27 (11 Nov 2026), the harder memory test (3d), written before any card or memory run on it: 24 earlier chats in look-alike pairs (two heist chats, two Nolan chats, two horror chats, two box-office flops, two Coen chats, two courtroom chats, two space chats...), spread over 2-120 days; 32 refer-backs that must pick the right one of each pair; 16 unrelated questions (some on topics next to a stored chat: a Jaws composer question beside the Dunkirk composer chat). Reported for MEM_EMBED and MEM_CARDS; not used to tune anything.

questions.question: Recommend a heist movie set in Europe
questions.answer: Rififi (1955) is the classic Paris heist with a silent 30-minute robbery; The Italian Job (1969) is the lighter Turin caper.

questions.question: What's a heist film where the plan goes wrong in real time?
questions.answer: Reservoir Dogs (1992) shows the aftermath of a botched robbery; Dog Day Afternoon (1975) is a bank job that turns into a standoff.

questions.question: Who did the music for Dunkirk?
questions.answer: Hans Zimmer scored Dunkirk, using a ticking watch and the Shepard tone to build tension.

questions.question: How did Christopher Nolan film the hallway fight in Inception?
questions.answer: The rotating hallway in Inception was a real set that turned on a giant rig, so Joseph Gordon-Levitt fought inside it.

questions.question: Slow-burn horror set in the countryside?
questions.answer: The Wicker Man (1973) and Midsommar (2019) both build dread in sunny rural communities.

questions.question: A horror film set entirely in one house at night?
questions.answer: The Others (2001) and The Innocents (1961) keep their ghosts inside one old house.

questions.question: Why was Heaven's Gate such a disaster?
questions.answer: Heaven's Gate (1980) ran far over budget, its first cut was over five hours, and it nearly sank United Artists.

questions.question: Why did John Carter lose so much money?
questions.answer: John Carter (2012) cost about $250 million, had confusing marketing, and earned too little to cover it.

questions.question: Good animated films for a 6-year-old who loves animals?
questions.answer: Zootopia (2016) and The Wild Robot (2024) are funny, gentle and full of animals.

questions.question: Animated movies for teenagers that aren't childish?
questions.answer: Spider-Man: Into the Spider-Verse (2018) and Akira (1988) work well for teens.

questions.question: Is Dune Part Two better than the first one?
questions.answer: Most critics liked Dune: Part Two (2024) even more than Part One, praising its scale and Austin Butler's villain.

questions.question: Should I read Dune before watching the 1984 version?
questions.answer: Reading the book helps: David Lynch's Dune (1984) cuts and compresses a lot of it.

questions.question: Japanese films about family dinners and quiet daily life?
questions.answer: Tokyo Story (1953) and Still Walking (2008) are gentle family dramas built around meals and visits.

questions.question: Korean films about class and money?
questions.answer: Parasite (2019) and Burning (2018) both look at class through very different stories.

questions.question: What's the best Coen brothers comedy?
questions.answer: The Big Lebowski (1998) is the most loved; Raising Arizona (1987) is their zaniest.

questions.question: Which Coen brothers film is the darkest?
questions.answer: No Country for Old Men (2007) is their bleakest, with Javier Bardem's unstoppable killer.

questions.question: Courtroom dramas where the verdict is a surprise?
questions.answer: Witness for the Prosecution (1957) and Primal Fear (1996) both turn on a late twist.

questions.question: Jury room films?
questions.answer: 12 Angry Men (1957) happens almost entirely in the jury room as one juror slowly changes the others' minds.

questions.question: Feel-good films about cooking?
questions.answer: Chef (2014) and Ratatouille (2007) are warm, funny food films.

questions.question: Documentaries about restaurants?
questions.answer: Jiro Dreams of Sushi (2011) follows a Tokyo sushi master and his sons.

questions.question: How long is The Irishman?
questions.answer: The Irishman (2019) runs 209 minutes, about three and a half hours.

questions.question: Who plays the young Vito Corleone?
questions.answer: Robert De Niro plays young Vito Corleone in The Godfather Part II (1974).

questions.question: Space movies about being stranded alone?
questions.answer: Moon (2009) and Gravity (2013) both strand one person far from home.

questions.question: Space movies about first contact with aliens?
questions.answer: Arrival (2016) and Contact (1997) are thoughtful first-contact stories.
